variables.variableName: Pixel count in lateral root(s) (filter F448)
variables.qc_recommended: >=0 integer;
variables.notes: Pixel count remains a separate family because it uses a different value type and scale from fluorescence intensity summaries. Canonical IDs are still filter-driven; biological interpretation is metadata rather than canonical identity.
variables.internal_codename_note: FC1 has F469, F483, F513, F565, F586, F593, glass filters; FC2 has F448, F513, F520, F593, F635, ChlF, glass filters; only FC2 has Red-Orange and Far-Red light sources.
variables.filter_notes: mCherry -> F635; coumarin-related -> F483; mTurquoise2 -> F513; GFP -> F513/F520; YFP-like -> F593
variables.methodDesc: Archived PSI fluorescence TAR files are unpacked to a single .dumm image, which is then horizontally flipped and aligned to the backlit-mask reference frame with filter- and unit-specific geometry presets. The same ROI quantification code is applied after alignment regardless of assay interpretation: transferred ROI masks are used to compute mean fluorescence, summed fluorescence, and ROI pixel count. The HADES FluorCam units are bottom-view systems for square Petri dishes with a 12.36 MP monochrome CMOS sensor, multichannel LED excitation, and motorized emission filter wheels.

variables.notes: Pixel count remains a separate family because it uses a different value type and scale from fluorescence intensity summaries. Canonical IDs are still filter-driven; biological interpretation is metadata rather than canonical identity.
variables.internal_codename_note: FC1 has F469, F483, F513, F565, F586, F593, glass filters; FC2 has F448, F513, F520, F593, F635, ChlF, glass filters; only FC2 has Red-Orange and Far-Red light sources.
variables.filter_notes: mCherry -> F635; coumarin-related -> F483; mTurquoise2 -> F513; GFP -> F513/F520; YFP-like -> F593
variables.methodDesc: Archived PSI fluorescence TAR files are unpacked to a single .dumm image, which is then horizontally flipped and aligned to the backlit-mask reference frame with filter- and unit-specific geometry presets. The same ROI quantification code is applied after alignment regardless of assay interpretation: transferred ROI masks are used to compute mean fluorescence, summed fluorescence, and ROI pixel count. The HADES FluorCam units are bottom-view systems for square Petri dishes with a 12.36 MP monochrome CMOS sensor, multichannel LED excitation, and motorized emission filter wheels.

variables.notes: Pixel count remains a separate family because it uses a different value type and scale from fluorescence intensity summaries. Canonical IDs are still filter-driven; biological interpretation is metadata rather than canonical identity.
variables.internal_codename_note: FC1 has F469, F483, F513, F565, F586, F593, glass filters; FC2 has F448, F513, F520, F593, F635, ChlF, glass filters; only FC2 has Red-Orange and Far-Red light sources.
variables.filter_notes: mCherry -> F635; coumarin-related -> F483; mTurquoise2 -> F513; GFP -> F513/F520; YFP-like -> F593
variables.methodDesc: Archived PSI fluorescence TAR files are unpacked to a single .dumm image, which is then horizontally flipped and aligned to the backlit-mask reference frame with filter- and unit-specific geometry presets. The same ROI quantification code is applied after alignment regardless of assay interpretation: transferred ROI masks are used to compute mean fluorescence, summed fluorescence, and ROI pixel count. The HADES FluorCam units are bottom-view systems for square Petri dishes with a 12.36 MP monochrome CMOS sensor, multichannel LED excitation, and motorized emission filter wheels.

variables.notes: Pixel count remains a separate family because it uses a different value type and scale from fluorescence intensity summaries. Canonical IDs are still filter-driven; biological interpretation is metadata rather than canonical identity.
variables.internal_codename_note: FC1 has F469, F483, F513, F565, F586, F593, glass filters; FC2 has F448, F513, F520, F593, F635, ChlF, glass filters; only FC2 has Red-Orange and Far-Red light sources.
variables.filter_notes: mCherry -> F635; coumarin-related -> F483; mTurquoise2 -> F513; GFP -> F513/F520; YFP-like -> F593
variables.methodDesc: Archived PSI fluorescence TAR files are unpacked to a single .dumm image, which is then horizontally flipped and aligned to the backlit-mask reference frame with filter- and unit-specific geometry presets. The same ROI quantification code is applied after alignment regardless of assay interpretation: transferred ROI masks are used to compute mean fluorescence, summed fluorescence, and ROI pixel count. The HADES FluorCam units are bottom-view systems for square Petri dishes with a 12.36 MP monochrome CMOS sensor, multichannel LED excitation, and motorized emission filter wheels.

variables.variableName: Seed shape - SSE
variables.qc_recommended: >=0; check heavy tails
variables.notes: Vendor public output labels this parameter as seed shape â€“ SSE (sum of square errors). Exact ellipse-fit algorithm and normalization remain undisclosed.
variables.methodDesc: Image-based seed descriptor emitted by the integrated Boxeed module during pre-sowing seed phenotyping. The HADES preparation table uses a PSI-integrated Boxeed seeder for automated seed handling and stores vendor-reported seed descriptors for downstream use; the exact internal derivation algorithm is not publicly specified. This variable records the vendor-reported ellipse-fit residual score.

variables.variableName: Seed Fluorescence intensity (%)
variables.notes: Boxeed public documentation lists seed fluorescence intensity (%) only for the optional fluorescence module, not the standard base system. Exact excitation/emission settings and quantification algorithm are not publicly disclosed.
variables.methodDesc: Image-based seed descriptor emitted by the integrated Boxeed module during pre-sowing seed phenotyping. The HADES preparation table uses a PSI-integrated Boxeed seeder for automated seed handling and stores vendor-reported seed descriptors for downstream use; the exact internal derivation algorithm is not publicly specified. This variable corresponds to the optional vendor fluorescence measurement reported as percent.

variables.variableName: Seed length
variables.qc_recommended: >=0; plausible range by species; no NaN expected
variables.methodDesc: Image-based seed descriptor emitted by the integrated Boxeed module during pre-sowing seed phenotyping. The HADES preparation table uses a PSI-integrated Boxeed seeder for automated seed handling and stores vendor-reported seed descriptors for downstream use; the exact internal derivation algorithm is not publicly specified. The vendor reports this dimension in millimeters after image-based seed measurement.

variables.variableName: Seed shape - L/S ratio
variables.qc_recommended: >0; check outliers

This variable records the vendor-reported length-to-area ratio (L/S ratio).
